newsitem.title: DENMARK: Novo signs licence deal with India's Reddy.
newsitem.headline: Novo signs licence deal with India's Reddy.

text.p: Danish biotechnology and pharmaceuticals group Novo Nordisk said on Monday it signed a research licensing deal with India's Dr. Reddy's Research Foundation.
It said in a statement that the deal gave Novo Nordisk an exclusive global licence to develop and market pharmaceutical products based on drugs patented by Dr Reddy's.
"The deal covers drugs which are expected to have a potential for treating diabetes, obesity, lipid disturbances and complications in connection with these illnesses," it said.

Novo said the deal with Dr Reddy's Research Foundation represented an important step in its attempts to widen the range of its research and gain access to drugs which could be used in the treatment of diabetes and complications.
